resources.title: — Zumdahl, Zumdahl & DeCoste, 11th ed., Cengage, ISBN 9780357850671
resources.why: The classic general-chemistry text used for AP and college. Strong thermodynamics and equilibrium — the two heaviest olympiad-physical-chemistry blocks.

resources.title: — David R. Klein, 4th ed., Wiley, ISBN 9781119659594
resources.why: Best-in-class for building mechanistic thinking — the skill olympiad organic questions actually test. SkillBuilder exercises.

resources.title: — Klein, Vol. 1 (ISBN 9781119837091) & Vol. 2 (ISBN 9781119837053), 6th ed.
resources.why: The famous thin companion. Vol. 2 covers aromatics + IR and NMR spectroscopy — both IChO Level 3 and absent from NEB. Highest value-per-rupee book on this list.

resources.title: — Atkins, Jones & Laverman, 7th ed., W. H. Freeman, ISBN 9781464183959
resources.why: "A rigorous treatment of chemistry from a physical chemistry perspective. Essential for students aiming for Study Camp and beyond." Deeper thermodynamics + quantum than any general text.

resources.title: — Clayden, Greeves & Warren, 2nd ed., OUP, ISBN 9780199270293
resources.why: The gold standard. "Exceptional mechanism explanations with curved arrows… advanced synthesis planning and retrosynthetic analysis." Required for IChO organic, which NEB does not reach.

resources.title: — Keeler & Wothers, 2nd ed., OUP, ISBN 9780199604135
resources.why: Integrated organic + inorganic + physical, with strong molecular orbital theory. "Ideal for advanced IChO-level preparation." MO theory is IChO Level 3 and completely absent from NEB.

resources.title: — David Harvey, DePauw University
resources.why: Covers modern instrumental analysis — IChO §12 Analytical chemistry and §8 Spectroscopy, both entirely outside NEB. The best free route into the largest Nepali syllabus gap.

resources.title: Official IChO Syllabus — Theoretical Part
resources.why: 12 sections, 326 entries, each tagged Level 1/2/3. §1 The atom · §2 Chemical bonding · §3 Chemical calculations · §4 Periodic trends · §5 Inorganic Chemistry · §6 Physical chemistry · §7 Chemical kinetics (homogeneous) · §8 Spectroscopy · §9 Organic Chemistry · §10 Polymers · §11 Biochemistry · §12 Analytical chemistry. This is the contract you train against.

resources.title: Official IChO Syllabus — Practical Part
resources.why: 5 sections: ① Synthesis of inorganic & organic compounds (33+ tagged techniques) ② Identification of inorganic & organic compounds ③ Determination of some inorganic & organic compounds ④ Special measurements and procedures ⑤ Evaluation of results. gaps.missing: ⭐⭐ STAN has no website. Nepal's chemistry olympiad national organiser exists only as a Facebook page and a Facebook group. There is no syllabus page, no results archive, no past-paper repository, no registration portal, no durable record of anything.
gaps.evidence: MoEST दफा ४(१)(ग) *requires* a recognised olympiad body to have its "सबै विवरण खुलेको मापदण्ड वा निर्देशिका वा प्रवन्ध… सार्वजनिक" (a published criteria/guideline document). STAN publishes none. Facebook posts are ephemeral, unindexed and unsearchable.
gaps.aiSpec: Build it yourself — this is the single highest-leverage action available to NSS Olympiad Hub. Create a static ncho.nepal / GitHub-Pages site with: ① the reconstructed ladder (Part 0B.3), ② all STAN Facebook notices mirrored + archived with permalinks, ③ results tables by year, ④ the syllabi generated in C-3/C-4, ⑤ the past-paper bank from C-2, ⑥ registration deadlines calendar, ⑦ STAN and STEM Foundation Nepal contacts. Then email STAN offering to hand it over.

gaps.missing: ⭐⭐ Zero published NChO past papers — at district, provincial or national level. Not one.
gaps.evidence: Contrast Physics: 6 real NePhO papers exist publicly. Chemistry has *nothing*. Students across all 7 provinces are preparing blind, and cannot calibrate difficulty at all.
gaps.aiSpec: Retrieve first: request papers from STAN via Facebook; ask the 20 IChO alumni (all 20 names are in Part 0A — they are reachable via LinkedIn/Nepal's STEM networks); ask the +2 colleges whose students won (NIST/National School of Sciences publicly celebrated its IBO/IChO students). If unretrievable, generate a full NChO Mock Series: 3 District papers (40 MCQ / 60 min, NEB Gr.11 only), 3 Provincial papers (50 MCQ + 5 structured / 2 h, NEB Gr.11+12), 3 National papers (Part I 60 MCQ + Part II 8 free-response + Part III 1 practical / spread over 2 sittings, mirroring the verified 16–17 April two-day format). Calibrate Part I to USNCO Local, Part II to INChO, Part III to USNCO National Part III. Include full solutions + a mark-allocation rubric.

gaps.missing: ⭐ No published NChO syllabus. A student cannot know what the district or provincial round covers.
gaps.evidence: Physics solved this: NPS prints the syllabus *on the exam paper*. STAN prints nothing.
gaps.aiSpec: Generate a "NChO District & Provincial Round Syllabus" derived by intersecting (a) the verified NEB Grade 11 & 12 Chemistry curricula (73 topics total, enumerated in §1.4 and §2.3) against (b) the IChO Level 1 + Level 2 entries (150 of 326 — extracted from the official syllabus PDF). Publish as a two-column table: *NEB chapter → IChO clause → Level tag → in/out of scope for District → in/out for Province.* This is mechanically derivable and would be the first such document in Nepal.

gaps.missing: ⭐⭐ No NEB → IChO gap map. This is the decisive document for Nepal, and nobody has written it.
gaps.evidence: The IChO syllabus has 326 entries across 12 sections. NEB Grade 11+12 has 73 topics across 5 sections. Cross-referencing them by hand shows entire IChO sections with no NEB counterpart at all: §8 Spectroscopy (IR, NMR, UV-vis, mass spec), §10 Polymers, §11 Biochemistry, §12 Analytical chemistry (instrumental), plus §2.4 Molecular orbital theory, §2.2 delocalization/resonance and §1.2.5–1.2.7 Schrödinger/quantum numbers — all Level 3.
gaps.aiSpec: Generate "NEB → IChO Gap Map": all 326 IChO syllabus entries, each tagged *Level 1/2/3*, with three columns — ① covered by NEB Gr.11? ② covered by NEB Gr.12? ③ what to study instead (name the exact free resource: Harvey *Analytical Chemistry 2.1* ch. X for §12; Klein *OC as a Second Language* Vol. 2 for NMR/IR; LibreTexts for §10/§11; Clayden ch. Y for §9). Output = a self-study curriculum for the 176 Level-3 entries, which is where every Nepali medal will come from.

gaps.missing: ⭐⭐ No system for working the IChO Preparatory Problems. Nepal receives ~30 theoretical + 7 practical problems with full solutions every January — and by IChO regulation these are the *only* route to Level-3 content (54 % of the syllabus). Nobody in Nepal organises the work.
gaps.evidence: IChO Regulations ¶10 (quoted verbatim in §4.1). Verified: the 2026 set is 30 theoretical + 7 practical with detailed solutions, on the official Drive. The 2001–2019 archive is complete on icho.sk.
gaps.aiSpec: Generate a "Preparatory Problems Working Programme": ① take the 19 archived sets (2001–2019) + 2024 + 2026 = 21 sets; ② tag every problem by IChO syllabus section (§1–§12) and Level; ③ produce a 12-month study calendar that walks all 21 sets in syllabus order, ~2 problems/week; ④ for each of the 12 sections, a "first 5 problems to do" shortlist; ⑤ a running Level-3 topic index so a student can see which prep-problem years taught, e.g., MO theory or NMR. This turns a pile of PDFs into a curriculum.

gaps.missing: ⭐⭐ NO PRACTICAL / EXPERIMENTAL CHEMISTRY TRAINING MATERIAL FOR NEPAL AT OLYMPIAD LEVEL. IChO has a 5-hour practical examination worth a substantial share of total marks. Nepal has never had one published resource for it.
gaps.evidence: The official IChO practical syllabus lists 33+ tagged techniques in §1 alone, many at Level 2–3: magnetic stirrer, reflux apparatus, distillation at reduced pressure, steam distillation, microscale synthesis, Büchner filtration with a water vacuum pump, recrystallisation from an unknown organic solvent, desiccator drying, gas-washing bottles, solvent extraction — plus §2 Identification, §3 Determination, §4 Special measurements, §5 Evaluation of results. Sajha Notes' NEB labs (Gr. 11 & 12) are board-level: titration, gravimetric analysis, salt analysis. The jump is enormous and unbridged. Aggravating factor: Nepal's only IChO medal (2022) was won in a remote IChO with no experimental part. The practical is now back and Nepal is unprepared for it.
gaps.aiSpec: Generate "Practical Chemistry for NChO & IChO — a Nepal Manual" in 5 parts matching the official syllabus sections: (1) Apparatus & technique literacy — analytical balance, burette/pipette/measuring cylinder, dropping funnel, reflux, simple + fractional + reduced-pressure distillation, steam distillation, Büchner funnel + water vacuum pump, recrystallisation, desiccator, magnetic stirrer, gas-washing bottle, separatory funnel; for each: purpose, setup diagram, procedure, common failure modes, safety. (2) Qualitative identification — cation/anion systematic analysis, flame tests, functional-group tests, melting/boiling-point determination, mixed-unknown schemes. (3) Quantitative determination — acid–base, redox (permanganometry, iodometry, dichromatometry), complexometric (EDTA), precipitation (argentometry), back-titrations; error propagation and % yield. (4) Instrumental/special — colourimetry & UV-vis calibration curves, potentiometry & pH-metric titration, conductivity, simple chromatography (TLC/paper), refractometry, polarimetry; plus PhET / virtual-lab / at-home substitutes for every technique a district school cannot perform (this is essential — most Nepali schools lack reduced-pressure distillation entirely). (5) Evaluation of results — significant figures, standard deviation, linearisation, least-squares fit with slope/intercept uncertainty, reporting a final value ± uncertainty. Anchor every item to the official IChO practical syllabus Level tags and to USNCO National Exam Part III (the only free published olympiad lab-practical archive) + the IChO 2026 Practical Exam and its solutions.

gaps.missing: No Nepali-language (नेपाली) chemistry olympiad material whatsoever.
gaps.evidence: Physics has the same gap, but chemistry is worse: IChO permits translation, INChO publishes papers in Hindi, and Devanagari-script chemistry vocabulary (e.g. *अनुमापन* for titration, *सान्द्रता* for concentration) is not standardised anywhere in Nepal. Sajha Notes is English-only.
gaps.aiSpec: Generate a bilingual नेपाली/English Chemistry Olympiad glossary: ~500 terms covering all 12 IChO sections, each with *Nepali term · English term · symbol · SI unit · governing equation*. Then translate the summary/key-concept boxes only (not full problems) of the C-4 gap map. Reference INChO's Hindi papers for consistent Devanagari scientific terminology.
